"""
parser.py
=========

A tolerant INI/TOML-ish configuration parser.

This module reads configuration files that mix INI and light TOML syntax.
It is intentionally forgiving: it skips comments, tolerates extra whitespace,
accepts several value styles (bare, quoted, booleans, integers, floats,
arrays of scalars), and can fall back to a set of defaults so that a
partially-written config file never crashes an application.

Quick examples
--------------
>>> from parser import parse_config
>>> cfg = parse_config("demo.ini"
